name: tui-tailscale
tagline: Self-hosted Tailscale from the terminal: join, route and manage this node
description:
Self-hosted Tailscale from the terminal, both ends of it: this machine as a tailnet node today, the [Headscale](https://headscale.net) control plane next. It drives the `tailscale` client, against a self-hosted Headscale or Tailscale's own.

The node screen shows the state, the login server, the node's name and addresses, and what it routes: accepted and advertised routes, the exit node in use, whether it offers one. The peers screen lists the tailnet: owner, address, online, exit node offers and subnets.

`j` joins: login server, optional pre-auth key, hostname and routes, previewed as one `tailscale up … --reset`. The key is typed masked and never put on a command line: it reaches tailscale through a root-only file that is removed after the join. Without a key the join shows the login URL to open in a browser, which is how an OIDC login happens. Each setting is one `tailscale set`; routing for others also turns IP forwarding on, in the same preview.

When `tailscale` is absent, `i` installs it with the distribution's package manager. `--demo` shows every screen with nothing installed.

keys.action: Join a tailnet: login server, optional pre-auth key, hostname, routes
Toggle accepting routes / edit the advertised subnet routes
Pick the exit node to use / toggle offering this node as one
Install tailscale from the package manager (when absent)

source.command:
git clone https://github.com/tui-tools/tui-tailscale
cd tui-tailscale && make demo

pacman.note: Available once the first release lands in pkgs.tui.tools.

apt.note: Available once the first release lands in pkgs.tui.tools.

dnf.note: Available once the first release lands in pkgs.tui.tools.

binary.command:
curl -fsSL https://github.com/tui-tools/tui-tailscale/releases/download/v{version}/tui-tailscale_{version}_linux_{arch}.tar.gz | tar -xz tui-tailscale
sudo install -m0755 tui-tailscale /usr/local/bin/tui-tailscale

security.needs_sudo: Every change escalates, previewed first: tailscale up/set/down/logout, the pre-auth key file under /run, the IP-forwarding sysctl and drop-in, and the install. Reading the node runs as you, retried through the prefix only if tailscaled refuses you.
security.no_network_note: No connection of its own. The one download is the install (i), on demand and previewed: curl fetches Tailscale's apt key and source list, or its dnf .repo, from pkgs.tailscale.com. A pre-auth key is never on a command line: tailscale reads it from a mode 600 file under /run, removed after the join.
